children: TJX Companies reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $15.18B and diluted EPS of $1.36, driven by comp store gains and higher average baskets that lifted profitability versus the year-ago quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth: Net sales rose 5% in the quarter and 7% year-to-date, supported by roughly 4–5% comparable-store sales and growth from non-comparable store contributions.
Channel mix: E-commerce remains a small portion of sales at about 2–3%; in-store comps and larger average baskets were key drivers.
Brand momentum: HomeGoods delivered strong comparable growth (~7% in the quarter, 8% YTD) and Marmaxx expansion continued to contribute.
Store expansion: Global store count and selling square footage increased about 3%; company raised its long-term store target to roughly 7,500 locations.
Operations: Tariff refund receipts helped merchandise margin; investments ongoing in supply chain, distribution centers, IT and new store openings.
